description: This PHP source file defines the TranslationHelper class, which handles internationalization processes such as loading translations from YAML files, interacting with a database to save translation records, and retrieving language-specific data. It's part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the installer utilities for version 1.

classes.name: TranslationHelper
classes.description: Provides methods to add translations from YAML files into the database, manage translation records, and retrieve language information within the OrangeHRM installation process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TranslationHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: addTranslations
methods.description: Loads translation data from a YAML file and saves each translation into the database.

methods.name: saveTranslationRecord
methods.description: Saves an individual translation record into the database, creating new entries if needed.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves the database ID for a given language code.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QueryBuilder instance for executing database queries.

methods.name: getTranslationRecord
methods.description: Checks if a translation record exists in the database and returns its ID if found.
